late_policy: Reject source_us < committed primary time; never current-state fallback
output_policy: Independent complete nominal and full covariance copy propagated from primary with raw body inputs; never fed back
output_acceleration: Velocity change of the prior committed output predicted with only newly received raw body intervals, before delayed measurement corrections; never use the fusion-corrected output jump as IMU acceleration
warmup: Primary remains at initial epoch until the horizon elapses; independent output prediction is available, fusion readiness remains unconfirmed
transaction: Candidate primary, every ready measurement and complete output propagation must succeed before committing primary/output or making completions available
failure: Preserve authoritative primary and last output state/P; latch numerical, model, identity, body-gap or raw-body-capacity faults; caller withdraws READY
event_capacity: Ordinary explicit rejection; producer watermark is consumed; previously queued work and valid output remain usable
completion_backpressure: Drain all committed completion copies before appending or advancing another cycle; bounded caller-owned processing, no callback registry
kf6_noise: Every original input interval retains original_dt_s in NavigationKf_PredictInterval for all fragments
eskf15_body: Preserve both calibrated raw half means and original dt; fragment propagation uses its own half and the current copy's residual biases
wire: Requires separately versioned request/completion and primary/output epoch evidence; frozen v2 remains unchanged
acceptance: Experimental development generation is available with the legacy default preserved. Acceptance remains incomplete until normal/fault differential tests, fresh generated gates and critical-contract/stack review are complete; CPU and compiler evidence does not establish hardware qualification
